table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	saleledger.saleinvcode , 
	saleledger.altersaleinvcode,
	saleledger.salecatcode , 
	saleledger.date , 
	saleledger.billingdate,
	saleledger.custrefno , 
	saleledger.remarks , 
	saleledger.custcode , 
	saleledger.shiptocustomer, 
	saleledger.salesmancode ,
	saleledger.headerno,  
	users.username , 
	saleledger.discperc , 
	saleledger.flatdisc , 
	saleledger.misccharges, 

	saleledger.misccharges1, 
	saleledger.misccharges2, 
	saleledger.misccharges3, 
	saleledger.misccharges4, 
	saleledger.misccharges5, 

	saleledger.salestax , 
	saleledger.posted , 
	saleledger.postdate , 
	customer.address1 , 
	customer.city , 
	customer.phone ,
	customerbalance = 0,
	debitorcredit = ' ',
	aliasname= (SELECT Accounts.AliasName FROM Accounts WHERE AccCode = SaleLedger.CustCode),
	saleledger.headerinvno,
	saleledger.originaldate,
	saleledger.modifiedby,
	saleledger.sprice,
	saleledger.quotationno,
	saleledger.postedby,
	saleledger.doctcode,
	patientRegNo=(SELECT P.RegNo FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode = saleledger.patientcode),
	saleledger.patientcode,
	PatientBalance=0.00,
	PointsBalance=ISNULL((SELECT SUM(LCL.PointsDebit - LCL.PointsCredit) FROM LoyaltyCardLedger LCL WHERE LCL.AccCode = SaleLedger.CustCode), 0),
	GuestRegNo=(SELECT G.RegNo FROM Guest G WHERE G.GuestCode=Saleledger.GuestCode),
	SaleLedger.GuestCode,
	SaleLedger.GuestCheckInCode,
	GuestBalance=0.00,
	StudentRegNo=(SELECT ST.RegNo FROM Student ST WHERE ST.StudentCode=SaleLedger.StudentCode),
	SaleLedger.StudentCode,
	StudentBalance=0.00,
	ChasisNo=(SELECT MV.ChasisNo FROM MotorVehicle MV WHERE MV.MotorVehicleCode=SaleLedger.MotorVehicleCode),
	SaleLedger.MotorVehicleCode,
	cashreceived,
	invGSTPerc1=saleledger.InvGstPerc1,
	dd_gstperc=0,
	gcode=0,
	saleledger.gstno,
	saleledger.PrintWaranty,
	saleledger.PrintBatch,
	saleledger.MessageCode,
	Message.Description,
	saleledger.SmanCode,
	Salesman.Name,
	saleledger.custrefno2,
	saleledger.custrefno3,
	saleledger.custrefno4,
	saleledger.InvoiceSize,
	saleledger.invtotal,
	saleledger.machinename,
	saleledger.ModifyCounter,
	saleledger.wardcode,
	saleledger.diseasecode,
	saleledger.relationcode,
	Saleledger.itemdiscpercno,
	saleledger.unreceivedbalance,
	Saleledger.admissioncode,
	Saleledger.printbalance,
	Saleledger.AccountFor,
	Saleledger.PaymentMode,
	Saleledger.PaymentAccCode,
	Saleledger.Amt,
	Saleledger.AmtBy,
	Saleledger.AmtDate,
	Saleledger.AmtReference,
	saleledger.Outstandingamt,
	saleledger.marked,
	saleledger.deliveredby,
	saleledger.prescode,
	saleledger.pptcustcode,
	saleledger.balance,
	saleledger.impactinventory,
	saleledger.saleordercode,
	saleledger.salecomments1,
	saleledger.salecomments2,
	saleledger.saletypecode,
	saleledger.recurringinvoice,
	saleledger.recurringperiod,
	saleledger.recurringagainst,
	saleledger.ConsiderInPO,
	saleledger.visitcode,
	saleledger.duedate,
	saleledger.SRBufferInvCode,
	saleledger.CustRefNo5,
	saleledger.SuppInvCode,
	saleledger.GRN,
	saleledger.GCCode,
	saleledger.Vehicle,
	saleledger.ShipTo,
	AssociatedPurInvCode = (SELECT MAX(PL.PurInvCode) FROM PurLedger PL WHERE PL.AssociatedSaleInvCode = :ar_SaleInvCode),
	saleledger.ModuleId,
	saleledger.DocCode,
	saleledger.GuaranteePersonCode,
	saleledger.CashTendered,
	saleledger.CashCharged,
	saleledger.CashBack,
	saleledger.cashacccode,
	saleledger.CustLicNo,
	saleledger.CustLicExpiry,
	saleledger.saletypeinvno,
	saleledger.custsitecode,
	Saleledger.currencycode,
	Saleledger.ConversionRate,
	Saleledger.PreviousReading,
	Saleledger.CurrentReading,
	Saleledger.NextChange,
	Saleledger.SourceSaleInvCode,
	Saleledger.FiscalInvoiceNo,
	Saleledger.AdvanceTax,
	Saleledger.AdvanceTaxAmt,
	SaleLedger.ContactCardCode,
	SaleLedger.FBRPOSFee,

	SaleLedger.PaidViaAPI,
	SaleLedger.PaymentAPI,
	SaleLedger.PaymentAPITranNo,
	SaleLedger.PaymentAPIOTP,

	SaleLedger.CashierShiftCode,

	SaleLedger.SiteCode,
	SaleLedger.TargetSiteCode

FROM  
	customer , 
	dbo.saleledger
	LEFT OUTER JOIN Dbo.SalesMan ON (saleledger.smancode = salesman.salesmancode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.message ON (saleledger.messagecode = message.messagecode),   
	users , 
	accounts  
WHERE 
	saleledger.custcode = customer.custcode and 
	users.usercode = saleledger.salesmancode and 
	saleledger.custcode = accounts.acccode and 
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = :ar_SaleInvCode
